title: Moon base: the new opening (a space film with action), first two shots
note: The first sentence of the same script, over two new action shots (base_scene.py with RIDE=1): NASA's crew rover at its published top speed on the Connecting Ridge, then two rovers in convoy. No counters, labels or cards.

shots.job: This shot shows the crew's rover at speed on the ridge, dust flying, so the viewer meets the people this is about before a word is said.
This shot shows two rovers travelling together across the ridge, so the viewer sees a working base, the thing the night threatens.

lines.say: A Moon base would face nights about three hundred and fifty-four hours long.
text: A Moon base would face nights
